title: Salt and Rain

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm (41): mines near Hormuz, a strike on a Gaza clinic, El Niño floods killing 34 in Ecuador and Peru, migrants dead off the Canaries. Smaller lights: Venezuela moves to let the opposition run, and India and Bangladesh ban paraquat.

lines: Two tankers found the mines before the morning did,
the Strait keeps all its secrets underneath the lid.
A clinic with its flag up, and the ceasefire signed,
two coats on the hook that won't be worn this time.
In Piura the river walked straight through the door,
Ecuador is counting what the rain came for.
A boat drifts toward the Canaries, nobody at the oar —
eight who crossed the water and can't cross any more.
Salt and rain, salt and rain,
the sea gives nothing back the same.
But Caracas opens one locked gate,
and the rice fields lose a poison — it's late, not too late.
